clues.text: On the way up the mountain, Isaac carried the wood and asked his father Abraham where this offering was.
In Egypt, each Israelite household put the blood of this animal on the sides and tops of their doorframes.
In Nathan's story to David, a poor man's only one slept in his arms like a daughter.
Before facing Goliath, David told Saul he had rescued one from the mouth of a lion or bear.
Isaiah foresaw a peaceful time when the wolf will live with this young animal.
Isaiah wrote that the suffering Servant was led like this to the slaughter and did not open His mouth.
In John's heavenly vision, one appeared slain in the center of the throne, with seven horns and seven eyes.
